description: This file defines the PlatformCaps class and its nested classes (WebBrowser, AccountInfo, DeviceInfo) within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. It includes data members related to platform capabilities, such as browser and device information, and provides Load functions to populate these structures.

classes.name: PlatformCaps
classes.description: Represents platform capabilities including account and device info, with nested classes for detailed information.

classes.name: PlatformCaps::WebBrowser
classes.description: Holds information about the web browser, such as type, version, and user agent string.

classes.name: PlatformCaps::AccountInfo
classes.description: Contains account-related information, including account ID, device ID, experience, MAC address, and session token status.

classes.name: PlatformCaps::DeviceInfo
classes.description: Holds device-related information such as quirks, MIME types, features, model, device type, capabilities, and network info.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Populates the respective class members with data retrieved via the provided service interface, optionally filtered by query string.
